title: Remote config (config.json on S3 behind CloudFront)
description: Read by the web app at load and every 2 minutes, and by the relay on every job (cached 30 s). Changing it is uploading a file; no deploy. It is public: never put keys or handles in it. Provider keys live in Secrets Manager and the blocked list in the relay's DynamoDB table.

routing.description: Per op, providers in order of preference. The relay sends a job to the first one whose capability sheet supports the op and that has a free slot; the UI shows controls from the first provider's sheet. An empty list turns the op off. When an op routes to runway, Runway is the floor of every job for it, picks included: a job that fails on another provider for a provider or account reason is made again once on Runway's default model (features/runway-fallback.clan).

queueTimeoutS.description: How long a job may wait in the queue for a free provider slot before it fails, per class (seconds). Optional: absent, the relay uses 1800 for image and video. jobTimeoutS still bounds a job once it runs.

capUsd.description: Global stop: new paid jobs are refused with spend_stop once confirmed + reserved reaches it.

flags.description: Kill switches and the D7 go/no-go flags. A control appears only when its flag is on AND the routed provider's sheet supports it.

dogfood.description: The beta's record (features/production-tool-dogfood.clan): the notice, the Beta tag and the thumbs in the web app, and POST /dogfood/* on the relay. Optional; absent means off.

clipPatch.description: Fix this moment (features/clip-moment-edit.clan): op clip_patch regenerates only a note's window and splices it back. Optional; absent means off (clip_patch answers flag_off). Separate from videoRegionEdit, which also unlocks boxed Aleph region edits.

Fix this moment's settings (features/clip-moment-edit.clan). Optional, every key too: absent means the defaults shown. model: which of the sheet's clip_patch models makes the window (aleph2; an alternate such as veo3.1 once it is on the sheet), chosen before the job runs. contextS: whole seconds of the take cut each side of the window and sent with it (0 keeps the price at the window's; 1 is an eval variant). crossfadeS: each seam's crossfade, inside the window. seamMin: Jude's relative-SSIM line for a seam; below it the take still lands, with his warning.
